identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate Enfortumab Vedotin Versus (vs) Chemotherapy in Subjects With Previously Treated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Cancer (EV-301)
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-Label, Randomized Phase 3 Study to Evaluate Enfortumab Vedotin vs Chemotherapy in Subjects With Previously Treated Locally Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Cancer (EV-301)

armGroups.label: Arm A: Enfortumab Vedotin 1.25 mg/kg
armGroups.description: Participants received 1.25 milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg) of body weight enfortumab vedotin by intravenous infusion over approximately 30 minutes on days 1, 8 and 15 of every 28-day cycle. Participants received study treatment until radiological disease progression as determined per investigator assessment or other discontinuation criteria were met or upon study termination, or study completion, whichever occurred first.

armGroups.label: Arm B: Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Participants received either 75 milligrams per square meter (mg/m\^2) docetaxel by IV infusion over approximately 1 hour or 320 mg/m\^2 vinflunine by IV infusion over approximately 20 minutes or 175 mg/m\^2 paclitaxel by IV infusion over approximately 1 hour on day 1 of every 21-day cycle. Participants received study treatment until radiological disease progression as determined per investigator assessment or other discontinuation criteria were met or upon study termination, or study completion, whichever occurred first.

armGroups.label: Cross-over Extension (COE)
armGroups.description: Eligible participants from chemotherapy arm who met the criteria for COE will receive 1.25 mg/kg of body weight enfortumab vedotin by intravenous infusion over approximately 30 minutes on days 1, 8 and 15 of every 28-day cycle until discontinuation criteria is met.
